{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Slurm resources:
#   --job-name=serene
#   --output=logs/serene.%J.out
#   --error=logs/serene.%J.err
#   --nodes=1
#   --time=24:00:00
#   --gres=gpu:4
#   --gpus-per-node=4
#   --mail-type=ALL
#   --mail-user=mb756@sussex.ac.uk

#flux: --job-name=serene
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: --time-limit=24h

# Omitted Slurm options: --gres=gpu:4 and --gpus-per-node=4
# Flux GPU requests are site/config dependent (often via custom resource types).
# Performance implication: job may start without GPUs (or with fewer than 4), causing failure or severe slowdown.

# Omitted Slurm options: --output/--error with %J token
# Slurm's %J/%j token (job id) is not portable in Flux output/error directives.
# Performance implication: none, but logs may overwrite/collide unless you choose unique filenames.

# Omitted Slurm options: --mail-type and --mail-user
# Flux does not provide a universal, built-in email notification directive in batch scripts.
# Performance implication: none on runtime performance, but you will not receive automatic job emails.

module load python/3.8.6
module load cuda/10.1
module load tensorflow/2.3.1

CONFIG_PATH="$HOME/SegU-Net/config"

source "$HOME/nnevn/bin/activate"
python segUNet.py "$CONFIG_PATH/net_Unet_lc.ini"
deactivate
"
}
